description: Header file defining structures and function prototypes for managing packed references (`packed-refs`) in a Git-like version control system. Provides interface for initializing reference stores, locking/unlocking, size query, and transaction necessity checks.

methods.name: packed_ref_store_init
methods.description: Initializes a packed reference store associated with a repository and directory, with specific store flags.

methods.name: packed_refs_lock
methods.description: Locks the packed-refs file for writing, returning 0 on success, and providing error details on failure.

methods.name: packed_refs_is_locked
methods.description: Checks if the packed-refs file is currently locked.

methods.name: packed_refs_size
methods.description: Retrieves the size of the packed-refs file or reports 0 if it does not exist.

methods.name: is_packed_transaction_needed
methods.description: Determines whether a given ref_transaction needs to be executed against the packed_ref_store.
